name: trend-only-subsignals-10m-threshold-015
rationale: Internal pattern: raising TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT 0.25 -> 1.0 (equal weights) improved 500k return by ~12-13.5 pp against the dev baseline on four consecutive windows (2026-10-25/28/31, 11-01), which means the reversion-dominated baseline mix is where the value is lost. Equal weighting still leaves RSI and Bollinger %B at half the composite. This removes the mean-reversion family entirely (REVERSION 1.0 -> 0.0) on top of the best measured family (600s spacing, allocation_threshold 0.15), to isolate whether the trend family alone has timing value. 'trend-weighted-subsignals' (trend 1.0 / reversion 0.25, 60s spacing, threshold 0.1) was rejected, but never on top of 600s/0.15. At 50k the lot floor is expected to make this degenerate; the 500k/5M diagnostics carry the information, scored on total_fees_jpy and excess_return_vs_static_mix_pct, not trade count.
code_change_summary: In TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs), set TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 0.25 to 1.0 and REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 1.0 to 0.0. After computing weight_sum, return None if weight_sum <= 0.0 (only reversion sub-signals present during partial warmup) so the result is never NaN. Update both constants' doc comments and add a NOTE naming this hypothesis. Update compute_btc_target_* unit tests' expected values where they legitimately change (rewrite, never delete, tests asserting reversion dominance) and add a regression test that an RSI-only IndicatorPoint returns None and a trend-only point returns the expected value. Run the equal-weight-10m-threshold-015 code (bc00fab) on the same window at all three capitals as an unregistered reference.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.

MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula or the aggregation expression; exactly two numeric constants change (TREND 0.25 -> 1.0 and REVERSION 1.0 -> 0.0). Because REVERSION becomes 0.0 the weighted-mean denominator can be zero when only RSI/%B are present (partial warmup): handle that by returning None when weight_sum <= 0.0, and document it.

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
